title.ja: Verb ていただきたい (te itadakitai)

explanation.en: The ていただきたい grammar point is used to express a polite request or a desire for someone to do something for you. It is formed by attaching いただきたい to the て-form of the verb. It is more polite than the て-form + ほしい construction.

structure.pattern: Verb-て form + いただきたい

examples.japanese: 資料をコピーしていただきたいです。
examples.romaji: Shiryou wo kopii shite itadakitai desu.
examples.english: I would like you to make copies of the documents.

examples.japanese: この仕事を手伝っていただきたいのですが。
examples.romaji: Kono shigoto wo tetsudatte itadakitai no desu ga.
examples.english: I would like to ask for your assistance with this work.

examples.japanese: もしよろしければ、指導していただきたいです。
examples.romaji: Moshi yoroshikereba, shidou shite itadakitai desu.
examples.english: If it is not too much trouble, I would like you to guide me.

examples.japanese: 駅まで送っていただきたいんですが。
examples.romaji: Eki made okutte itadakitain desu ga.
examples.english: I was wondering if you could give me a ride to the station.
